purpose: Native smoke validation for PR #331. These short runs verify package installation, compilation, execution and result validity; they are not performance rankings. The initial sweep found Gleam shell grouping, MicroPython package selection and Odin file API failures. Follow-up runs validate those fixes and a C control. MicroPython 1.27.0 then failed ten upstream Nix package tests; 1.26.0 is used and validated instead.

targets.Compile: dotnet new console -n leibniz -o _build --force && cp leibniz.cs _build/Program.cs && cd _build && dotnet publish -c Release -r linux-x64 --self-contained -o ../out
dotnet new console -n leibniz -o _build --force && cp leibniz-simd.cs _build/Program.cs && cd _build && dotnet publish -c Release -r linux-x64 --self-contained -o ../out
cp leibniz.gleam leibniz_app/src/leibniz_app.gleam && cp rounds.txt leibniz_app/ && cd leibniz_app && gleam build

julia -e 'using Pkg; Pkg.activate("julia"); Pkg.instantiate(); isempty(Pkg.Registry.reachable_registries()) && Pkg.Registry.add("General"); Pkg.Apps.add(PackageSpec(name="JuliaC", version="0.3.10"))' && /tmp/bench-julia-depot/bin/juliac --output-exe leibniz --trim --experimental --bundle bun julia

uv venv /app/.mojo && uv pip install --python /app/.mojo/bin/python --require-hashes -r mojo-requirements.txt && /app/.mojo/bin/mojo build -O3 leibniz.mojo -o leibniz && patchelf --force-rpath --set-interpreter "$(cat $NIX_CC/nix-support/dynamic-linker)" --set-rpath "$(patchelf --print-rpath leibniz):$(dirname $(g++ -print-file-name=libstdc++.so.6))" leibniz
nasm -f elf64 leibniz.asm -o leibniz.o && gcc -o leibniz leibniz.o
rustc -C opt-level=3 -C target-cpu=native -C lto=fat -C codegen-units=1 -C panic=abort -o leibniz leibniz.rs
rustc -C opt-level=3 -C target-cpu=native -C lto=fat -C codegen-units=1 -C panic=abort -C llvm-args=-enable-unsafe-fp-math -o leibniz leibniz.rs
rustc -C debuginfo=0 -C opt-level=3 -C target-cpu=native -C lto=fat -C codegen-units=1 -C panic=abort leibniz_nightly.rs -o leibniz
rustc -C opt-level=3 -C target-cpu=native -C lto=fat -C codegen-units=1 -C panic=abort -o leibniz leibniz_simd.rs
